<thought>To find the template that corresponds to the DIBAL‑H reduction of an ester to an alcohol (breaking a C=O bond and forming a C‑O single bond), I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that break an “ester” functional group and form an “alcohol” functional group. This should return the template(s) that can be applied to the target molecule and that produced the precursors listed earlier. Once I have the template, I can retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and its integer ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
